column2: Sukhdev Singh v. Sukhbir Kaur, 2025 SCC OnLine SC 299
column12: Whether a spouse of marriage which is void as under s. 11 is entitled to permanent alimony or maintenance; whether during pendency of suit u/s. 11 of HMA a spouse can seek pendente lite.
column13:
A spouse whose marriage is declared void under s. 11 of HMA is entitled to permanent alimony/ maintenance and pendente lite on similar terms as divorced spouse. 
Court made discussions and clarified that s. 125 CrPC and s. 25 HMA are separate and the latter allows both husband & wife to claim. The court was also dissatified with the use of degrading terms such "illegitimate wife" and "faithful mistress" by the lower courts for referring women spouses of void marriage, while the similar classification was not done upon the male counterparts.
